title: Viscosity Supersolution Barriers to a Non-local Free Boundary Problem
abstract: arXiv:2609.02381v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study a parabolic obstacle partial integro-differential equation (PIDE) with a dynamically moving bilateral free boundary. This type of problem arises in the mathematical modeling of speculative asset bubbles with L\'evy jump processes. We consider the existence of viscosity supersolutions within the class of functions exhibiting linear asymptotic growth ($O(|g|)$ at infinity) across three distinct parametric regimes. Our intention is to determine when such a supersolution barrier can be built by analyzing the balance between the stabilizing local drift, defined by the discount rate $r$ and mean-reversion $\rho$, and the non-local jump dispersion, characterized by the large-jump intensity $\lambda$ and Lipschitz constant $L_\gamma$. First, when $r+\rho > \sqrt{\lambda}L_\gamma$, we prove the global existence of non-negative viscosity supersolutions. translated_title: 非局部自由边界问题的粘性上解障碍
translated_abstract: 我们研究一类具有动态移动双边自由边界的抛物型障碍偏积分微分方程（PIDE）。这类问题出现在基于Lévy跳跃过程的投机性资产泡沫数学建模中。我们在三个不同的参数区域中，考虑在具有线性渐近增长（在无穷远处为O(|g|)）的函数类中粘性上解的存在性。我们的目标是通过分析由贴现率r和均值回归ρ所定义的稳定局部漂移，与由大跳跃强度λ和Lipschitz常数L_γ所刻画的非局部跳跃弥散之间的平衡，来确定何时能够构建这样的上解障碍。首先，当r+ρ > √λ·L_γ时，我们证明了非负粘性上解的全局存在性。其次，在亏损区域（r+ρ < √λ·L_γ）中，我们证明了……
tldr: 本文针对源于Lévy跳跃过程下投机性资产泡沫建模、具有动态双边自由边界的抛物型障碍PIDE问题，通过分析稳定局部漂移与非局部跳跃弥散之间的平衡，证明了当r+ρ > √λ·L_γ时线性增长的非负粘性上解障碍的全局存在性。
en_tdlr: This paper proves the global existence of non-negative viscosity supersolution barriers with linear growth for a parabolic obstacle PIDE with a dynamically moving bilateral free boundary (arising from speculative asset bubble modeling with Lévy jumps), by analyzing the balance between stabilizing local drift and non-local jump dispersion, showing existence when r+ρ > √λ·L_γ.
